pitfalls.summary: Tables are wp_posts rows (post_type=tablepress_table, public=false) with no dedicated table and no show_in_rest -- reading the posts table WITHOUT this entity's declared where-filter would return every post type on the site (1546 rows on poratus.wpcomstaging.com: products, pages, attachments, etc.), not just TablePress tables. sampleStructureRequest.where is mandatory here, not optional -- enforced by plugin-knowledge.js's SHARED_CORE_TABLES_REQUIRING_WHERE check.
post_content holds the whole table as a JSON blob (row/column array), not display-ready text -- must be parsed, not copied verbatim, before any target mapping can use individual cell values.

VERIFIED LIVE 2026-08-29: a filtered query against poratus.wpcomstaging.com's posts table (where post_type = tablepress_table) found zero rows. The plugin is active but unused on this specific site -- the mechanism is real and reachable, there is simply nothing to migrate here today.

blocked.resolution: wix-wp-plugin-v2 can read the shared posts table filtered to this plugin's post_type -- VERIFIED LIVE 2026-08-29 against poratus.wpcomstaging.com: a filtered query (where post_type = tablepress_table) executes correctly and returns pagingMetadata.total: 0 (no TablePress tables configured on this site). Reachability is confirmed; fulfillment wiring is deferred until a Wix target is researched and approved at the mapping review. The working filtered query, for reference once a target is approved: select ID/post_title/post_content/post_status/post_date where post_type=tablepress_table, orderBy ID asc.

quirks: Registers custom post type tablepress_table (public=false): table JSON lives in post_content with post_mime_type application/json. Confirmed via the plugin's own source (model-post.php).

No native Wix target researched or approved yet -- do not assume a generic CMS collection is the right landing spot without that approval. Do not wire the table-definition entity's blocked[] fulfillment on your own judgment before that target decision is made.
